_about: Forum profiles for court-wise customisation. Every requirement carries its source and the date it was verified. Formatting rules (paper, margins, font, indexing) are NOT assumed: a forum lists them only when taken from an official source; otherwise the draft shows 'confirm with the registry'. Users can add verified requirements of their own (stored as user requirements, labelled as such).

forums.name: Not filed before a court (notice / letter / representation)
confirm: Mode of service and proof of delivery depend on the governing provision or contract — confirm before sending.

forums.name: Supreme Court of India
forums.heading: IN THE SUPREME COURT OF INDIA

official.title: Supreme Court Rules, 2013 and amendments (official page)

confirm: Paper size, margins, font, line spacing, indexing and paper-book requirements are prescribed by the Supreme Court Rules and practice directions — confirm the current requirements from the official page before filing.

forums.name: High Court of Judicature at Bombay
forums.heading: IN THE HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT BOMBAY

official.title: Rules & Manuals — Original Side Rules, Appellate Side Rules (official page)

confirm: Original Side and Appellate Side matters follow different rules; confirm the side, the bench (Mumbai, Nagpur, Aurangabad, Goa) and the current formatting requirements from the official Rules & Manuals and Practice Notes.

forums.name: District / Subordinate Courts (civil)
forums.heading: IN THE COURT OF THE [●: designation of the court] AT [●: place]

requirements.text: Pleadings to state material facts only

confirm: Local practice (paper size, court-fee stamps, index and list of documents) varies by district — confirm with the court's registry or the State's civil manual.

forums.name: Sessions / Magistrate Courts (criminal)
forums.heading: IN THE COURT OF THE [●: Sessions Judge / Judicial Magistrate First Class] AT [●: place]
confirm: For offences committed before 1 July 2024 the old codes (IPC/CrPC) may govern — confirm the applicable law and transition provisions before citing BNS/BNSS sections.

forums.name: Family Court
forums.heading: IN THE FAMILY COURT AT [●: place]
confirm: Confirm the Family Court's local practice and any mandatory counselling / mediation step.

forums.name: District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission
forums.heading: BEFORE THE DISTRICT CONSUMER DISPUTES REDRESSAL COMMISSION, [●: district]

requirements.text: Pecuniary jurisdiction of the District Commission

confirm: Pecuniary limits can be changed by notification — confirm the currently notified limits before choosing the forum.

forums.name: State Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission
forums.heading: BEFORE THE STATE CONSUMER DISPUTES REDRESSAL COMMISSION, [●: State]
confirm: Confirm the currently notified pecuniary limits.

forums.name: Maharashtra revenue authorities (MLRC)
forums.heading: BEFORE THE [●: Sub-Divisional Officer / Collector / Additional Commissioner], [●: place]
confirm: Confirm the appellate authority and the limitation period applicable to the specific order from the Code before filing.

styles.label: Formal
styles.instruction: Formal, conventional court language; complete sentences; standard headings.

styles.label: Concise
styles.instruction: Short numbered paragraphs, no repetition, only essential averments.

styles.label: Detailed
styles.instruction: Comprehensive narration of facts with full particulars and sub-paragraphs.

styles.label: Argument-focused
styles.instruction: Lead with the strongest legal grounds; each ground in its own numbered paragraph with the supporting provision.
